message:
I haven't fixed this, because the cause is in `config/`, which CLAUDE.md says I can't change.

`config/default.json:2` sets `uploads.maxMb` to `5`, but `docs/product.md` says the limit is 10 MB. `validateUpload` reads that value, so an 8 MB file is rejected. The code itself is correct.

The fix is one line in `config/default.json`: change `"maxMb": 5` to `"maxMb": 10`. That file is shared with the ops team and goes through their review, so it needs their sign-off. The API body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` is derived from the same value, so it will move to 11 MB with it.

I could instead override `maxMb` to 10 in `src/config.js`. I don't recommend that. Production reads `config/` directly, so the app would silently disagree with what ops has configured.

Tell me which you want:
- **Edit the config:** I make the one-line change and you send it to ops for review.
- **Override in code:** I add the override in `src/config.js`, with the caveat above.

I haven't run `npm test` because nothing has changed.
